$comment: Taxonomy-valued fields carry an x-taxonomy annotation naming the dimension in factory/policies/taxonomy.yml. The runtime validates those values against that file at write time; enums are never inlined here to avoid drift between the schema and the taxonomy (architecture §8).
title: Event
description: One record in state/events/*.jsonl, the factory's durable execution substrate (architecture §7). Field names follow §7's record shape exactly: {ts, session_id, actor, event_type, task_id?, agent_id?, plan_version, causal_parent, payload}.

session_id.description: Names one event log file -- logPath() interpolates it into <dir>/<session_id>.jsonl -- and is also the key half of an event id, <session-id>#<index>. So it must be a single non-empty path segment. Structural, not a charset: '#' stays legal because parseEventId splits on the LAST one deliberately, and a '#' cannot move a file. This mirrors requireSessionIdShape() in events.ts, which guards every read and every write; an id that validator can already open satisfies this by construction, so no record on disk is rejected by it (D-197).

actor.description: Who emitted the event: 'user', 'system', an agent role, or a concrete agent_id.

event_type.description: Free string, not an enum — a closed list here would reject a new event type at write time and lose the record. e.g. user_prompt, dispatch_decision, error-logged, or one of the gate_event / graph_event taxonomy values (taxonomy.yml).

task_id.description: Optional — absent for session-level or epic-level events. Absence is the whole signal (agents-registry.ts folds a dispatch with no task id as epic-level), so "" is not a way to say it: minLength 1 keeps the field to two states instead of three (D-244).

agent_id.description: Optional — concrete instance id (e.g. coder-142), not a taxonomy role. Present means it names an instance; "" names none, so it is refused rather than written (D-244).

causal_parent.description: Event id of the event that caused this one; null only for session-root events.

project.description: Optional plain-string project identifier (Phase 6b, architecture §8) — NOT a closed taxonomy.yml vocabulary value, so no x-taxonomy annotation here. Absent on every event logged before Phase 6b; db/queries.ts's read helpers treat an absent/null project as the default 'black-smith'. That default is reached by absence, so "" would slip past it and name a project called nothing (D-244).
